title: Hoffman/Quotes
summary:
"Don't forget the other two, Sophie Casterwill and that traitor Zhalia Moon."
- Hoffman to Wilder and Stack about the Huntik team, (Doorway to Huntik)

"Sorry miss, your call cannot be completed as dialled!"
- Hoffman attacks Annette, (The Tower of Nostradamus)

"In my day, cowards like you would have never been allowed in the Organization."
- Hoffman to his Suits, (Knight of the Willblade)

"If we follow, they will pick us off again."
- Hoffman to Wilder, (Knight of the Willblade)

"The Professor that I remember didn't need lies to control anyone, the man had absolute power."
- Hoffman to Stack about the Professor, (Chasing Void)

"I'm getting too old for this..."
- Hoffman, after being beaten by Sophie Casterwill, (Zhalia's Mission)

"Cortés's vault, I never thought I'd live to see it."
- Hoffman about Hernán Cortés's vault, (The Power of Umbra)

"I've seen this happen before; it's never good"
- Hoffman to a Suit, (The Power of Umbra)

"Do not be so sure. I followed the Professor, and I refuse to let Huntik Foundation punks run through his castle like they own the place!"
- Hoffman to Den Fears, (An Ally from the Organization)

"In the Professor's name, stop those two!"
- Hoffman to the Elite Suit's about Dante and Grier, (An Ally from the Organization)

"Sorry, I'm stubborn when I make up my mind."
- Hoffman to Dante, (An Ally from the Organization)
